checks.name: html-parse
checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
parser = HTMLParser()
parser.feed(Path('index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
parser.close()
print('HTML parse ok')
PY
